name: GetResponse
description_en:
GetResponse combines email campaigns, autoresponders and marketing-automation workflows with acquisition and content-monetization tools. An automation message is sent because a contact reaches an action after the workflow’s conditions and filters, rather than inheriting a copied newsletter’s send schedule.

The current product family separates Starter, Marketer, Creator and Enterprise. Contacts, duplicate list entries, repeat actions and over-limit imports all affect operation or cost. This profile follows those concrete distinctions and treats the first premium-access period separately from the continuing Free account. No campaign, purchase or integration was executed.
description_zh:
GetResponse 将邮件活动、自动回复和营销自动化流程，与获客及内容变现工具结合。自动化邮件由联系人经过条件和筛选后到达发送动作而发出，不会继承所复制简报的发送时间。

现行产品家族区分 Starter、Marketer、Creator 和 Enterprise。联系人、重复名单条目、重复动作及超额导入，都会影响运营或成本。本文按这些具体区别展开，并区分最初高级功能体验期和持续 Free 账户；未实际执行活动、购买或集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Conditions and filters govern sending; copying a design does not copy its sending schedule.
core_features.explanation_zh: 由条件和筛选控制发送；复制设计不复制发送时间。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure whether a workflow element runs once, always or after a waiting period.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置流程元素只运行一次、每次运行或经过等待期后运行。

core_features.explanation_en: Unpublishing stops entry and freezes current progress until the workflow is published again.
core_features.explanation_zh: 取消发布会停止进入并冻结现有进度，重新发布后继续。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans differentiate forms, landing pages, ecommerce, courses, webinars and enterprise messaging.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐分别约束表单、落地页、电商、课程、网络研讨会和企业消息。

en: Build a permissioned signup course with workflow-controlled lessons.
Inspect import queues and duplicate billing during a newsletter migration.
zh: 建立已许可订阅、由流程控制课文发送的课程。
迁移简报时检查导入队列和重复计费。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Prepare list fields and distinguish newsletters, autoresponders and workflow messages.
steps.zh: 准备名单字段，区分简报、自动回复和流程邮件。

steps.en: Test a representative entry and review each element’s repeat setting.
steps.zh: 测试代表性进入并检查每个元素的重复设置。

steps.en: Confirm post-trial permissions, queue behavior and the billing tier.
steps.zh: 确认试用后权限、队列行为及计费档位。

items.en: A duplicated contact can incur multiple billing entries even when a newsletter is deduplicated.
items.zh: 即使简报投递去重，重复联系人仍可能占多个计费条目。

items.en: Copied automation messages do not retain the original send schedule or A/B test execution.
items.zh: 复制的自动化邮件不继承原发送排程或 A/B 测试执行。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Euro-rendered Starter/Marketer/Creator monthly starts €16/€54/€62; annual equivalents €13.12/€44.28/€50.84 before tax. Contact growth/additions and add-ons affect total; Free premium access lasts 14 days.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 欧元页面月付起价 €16／€54／€62，年付税前月均 €13.12／€44.28／€50.84。联系人增长、新增量和附加项影响总额；Free 高级功能体验为 14 天。

sources.title: How does GetResponse pricing work?
sources.research_notes_en: Peak active count and contacts added determine bill; duplicate list entries count separately. Webinar capacity statements conflict within article.

sources.title: Will the same contact on two lists get a message several times?
sources.research_notes_en: Newsletter deduplication differs from workflow Unique contacts filter and multi-list autoresponders.

sources.title: Can I run specific actions and conditions multiple times?
sources.research_notes_en: Actions/conditions default to once; repeat always or within interval; loops may resend and affect other workflows.

sources.title: What happens when I unpublish a workflow?
sources.research_notes_en: Unpublish freezes current contacts, blocks entry and republish should resume; save/publish required.

sources.title: What is a marketing automation message and how does it work?
sources.research_notes_en: Copying a message retains content but not send settings or A/B execution; source keeps sending independently.

sources.title: What is the Contact queue and how does it work?
sources.research_notes_en: Manual/import over-limit contacts queue; other methods may incur list extension. Queued free contacts removed after 32 days without upgrade.

sources.title: Can I try GetResponse before I buy?
sources.research_notes_en: Ongoing Free account and first 14-day premium access differ; later scheduling, automation, autoresponders and reports unavailable.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A copied message does not copy its send logic
sections.title_zh: 复制邮件不会复制发送逻辑
sections.en:
The automation-message guide says selecting an existing newsletter, autoresponder or A/B message creates an automation copy of its content. Sending is then governed by the workflow, and the original message keeps its own behavior. A copied A/B design does not continue the original test.

For an illustrative signup course, prepare the lesson content, then define the subscription condition, waits and send action. Check both source and copied messages so the original autoresponder does not unintentionally remain a second channel to the same people.
sections.zh:
自动化邮件指南说明，选择已有简报、自动回复或 A/B 邮件，会复制其内容作为自动化邮件，之后由流程决定发送，原邮件仍保留自身行为；复制 A/B 设计不会延续原测试。

例如订阅课程，应先准备课文，再定义订阅条件、等待和发送动作。应同时检查原邮件与副本，避免原自动回复无意中成为向同一人重复发送的另一条渠道。

sections.title_en: Billing duplicates and delivery duplicates are separate
sections.title_zh: 计费重复与投递重复分开看
sections.en:
The billing article counts an address separately in every list. The sending guide says a Newsletter can deduplicate across lists, but an automation may need its Unique contacts filter, and identical autoresponder sequences on separate lists can reach the same person more than once.

For example, 300 people each present on two lists can represent 600 billed entries even if a newsletter reaches 300 unique addresses. This hypothetical example shows why one delivered copy is not evidence of one billed contact.
sections.zh:
计费文章将同一邮箱在每个名单中分别计数。发送指南说明 Newsletter 可跨名单去重，但自动化可能需要 Unique contacts 筛选，多个名单上的相同自动回复序列仍可能重复发送。

假设 300 人各在两个名单中，即使一场简报只送到 300 个不同邮箱，也可能形成 600 个计费条目。这个算例说明，只收到一封不代表只计一个联系人。

sections.title_en: Repeat behavior belongs to each workflow element
sections.title_zh: 重复行为在每个流程元素上配置
sections.en:
Actions and conditions default to one pass per contact, according to the repetition guide. Run multiple times can allow every pass or enforce a waiting interval. The subscription condition is an exception because a contact subscribes once.

A repeated click or another purchase should not be assumed to restart the intended follow-up unless the relevant elements permit it. A loop can also resend and change tags or scores used by another workflow. Model the exit and maximum intended communication frequency before enabling repetition.
sections.zh:
重复指南说明，动作和条件默认每位联系人只经过一次。Run multiple times 可允许每次经过，或设定等待间隔；订阅条件因只订阅一次而属于例外。

再次点击或购买，不应被直接当作会重新启动跟进，相关元素必须允许重复。循环还可能重发并改变其他流程使用的标签或分数。启用前应设计退出及可接受的最大沟通频率。

sections.title_en: Unpublish to freeze, then explicitly publish again
sections.title_zh: 取消发布冻结后需明确重新发布
sections.en:
The unpublish guide says no new contacts can enter a draft workflow. Current contacts freeze rather than being removed and should move forward when published again. It recommends Save and publish in the editor to ensure restart.

Before editing a live course, record where representative learners are waiting and compare their next step after republication. This is an acceptance suggestion, not a recovery guarantee measured here. Different products use different stop semantics, so do not import assumptions from a previous email service.
sections.zh:
取消发布指南说明草稿流程不接收新联系人，现有人会冻结而不被移除，重新发布后应继续；指南建议在编辑器中点击 Save and publish 确保重启。

修改活跃课程前，可记录代表性学员的等待位置，重新发布后比较下一步。这是验收建议，并非本文测得的恢复保证。不同产品停止语义不同，不能沿用原邮件服务的假定。

sections.title_en: Deleting contacts does not erase the month’s additions
sections.title_zh: 删除联系人不会抹去当月新增量
sections.en:
The billing guide considers both peak active contacts and the total added during a billing month. Replacing one imported audience with another can therefore exceed the purchased list size even if the current visible total stays low. Pricing is not simply a meter of today’s list count.

The contact-queue guide adds a separate operational distinction: over-limit imports or manual additions can wait in a queue, while other subscription methods may trigger a list-extension fee. Check both the queue and billed list tier after a migration rather than assuming all submitted contacts reached the list.
sections.zh:
计费指南同时考虑账单月内的最高活跃联系人和总新增量。即使当前可见总人数很低，反复导入替换受众仍可能超出购买容量，价格不是只按今天名单人数计算。

联系人队列指南还区分：超限导入或手动新增可能进入队列，其他订阅方式可能触发名单扩展费。迁移后应同时检查队列与计费档位，不能假定所有提交联系人已进入名单。

sections.title_en: The first 14 days do not describe the continuing Free account
sections.title_zh: 前 14 天不代表持续 Free 账户
sections.en:
The Free guide describes a continuing account with up to 500 contacts and initial 14-day premium access. After that, it permits newsletters but disables scheduling, active autoresponders, automation messages, message reports and other premium functions unless upgraded. The premium period is not evidence that an automated course can run free indefinitely.

Queued free-account contacts are removed after 32 days without upgrade according to the queue guide. If a launch depends on a workflow or integration, inspect what remains available after the introductory period before starting it.
sections.zh:
Free 指南描述可持续使用的最多 500 位联系人账户，以及最初 14 天高级功能体验。此后可以发简报，但不升级就不能排程、启用自动回复、发送自动化邮件或访问消息报表等高级功能。因此，体验期能运行不代表自动课程可以长期免费运行。

队列指南还说明，不升级时免费账户排队联系人会在 32 天后移除。上线活动若依赖流程或集成，应在启动前确认体验期后仍能使用的能力。

sections.title_en: Match the marketing task to the actual product tier
sections.title_zh: 按营销任务选择真实档位
sections.en:
The retrieved euro view shows monthly starting cards of €16 Starter, €54 Marketer and €62 Creator, or annual-payment equivalents €13.12, €44.28 and €50.84, before local taxes. Starter lists one custom automation, while higher tiers list unlimited workflows. Creator adds courses and webinars; Enterprise has a custom offer.

GetResponse is worth evaluating when one operator needs acquisition and email flows together. Confirm capacity and add-ons rather than assuming every adjacent module is included. The billing help contradicts itself on Creator webinar attendee quantities, so this profile leaves that entitlement unresolved. Self-hosting and source licensing were not established.
sections.zh:
本次欧元页面显示月付起价 Starter €16、Marketer €54、Creator €62，年付月均分别为 €13.12、€44.28、€50.84，未含当地税费。Starter 列出一个自定义自动化，高档位列出不限流程；Creator 增加课程及网络研讨会，Enterprise 单独报价。

同时需要获客和邮件流程的运营者可评估 GetResponse，但应确认容量与附加项，不能假定所有相邻模块均已包含。计费帮助对 Creator 网络研讨会人数前后矛盾，本文保留该权限待核。自托管与源码许可尚未确认。

research_gaps.en: Creator webinar attendee allowances conflict within official billing help; exact entitlement, checkout total and region-dependent add-ons need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 官方计费帮助中的 Creator 网络研讨会人数互相冲突；确切权限、结算总额及地区附加项需确认。

research_gaps.en: No account, import, send, workflow recovery, purchase or integration was executed. UI languages, source license, deployment rights and contract data location remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际执行账户、导入、发送、流程恢复、购买或集成；界面语言、源码许可、部署权利及合同数据位置仍未核实。
